formulas.expression: IF({!IsFirstPaymentNSF}, 'Waiting For First Payment', 'First Missed Payment')

textTemplates.name: FirstNSFClientTemplate
textTemplates.text:
Dear {!Get_Related_Contact_Details.Name},

I hope this message finds you well.

I attempted to reach you regarding your missed payment but haven’t yet received a response. It’s important that we maintain open communication to ensure the smooth continuation of your program. As outlined in your contract, missing two or more payments may affect your legal coverage and eligibility, and we want to avoid any potential issues.

Could you please return my call at your earliest convenience? Could you confirm whether this payment will be processed as planned?

Your prompt attention to this matter would be greatly appreciated. I look forward to your response.

textTemplates.name: SecondNSFLegalClientTemplate
textTemplates.text:
Dear {!Get_Related_Contact_Details.Name},

I urgently need to discuss your missed payment, as I’ve been unable to reach you despite previous attempts. You are currently being represented in a lawsuit with ({!GetLenderName}). To avoid any disruptions to your program and potential issues with legal coverage, it's crucial that we address this matter promptly. 

Please return my call as soon as possible. Can you confirm whether this payment will be processed as planned?

Your immediate attention to this issue is essential. I look forward to your prompt response.

textTemplates.name: SecondNSFNoLegalClientTemplate
textTemplates.text:
Dear {!Get_Related_Contact_Details.Name},

I urgently need to discuss your missed payment, as I’ve been unable to reach you despite previous attempts. To avoid any disruptions to your program and potential issues with legal coverage, it's crucial that we address this matter promptly.

Could you please return my call at your earliest convenience? Additionally, please confirm whether your next payment will be processed as planned?

Your immediate attention to this issue is essential. I look forward to your prompt response.

textTemplates.name: ThirdNSFClientTemplate
textTemplates.text:
Dear {!Get_Related_Contact_Details.Name},

I hope you're doing well. I'm following up regarding the unresolved payment issues on your account. As previously discussed and outlined in your contract, missing two or more payments results in the loss of legal coverage and seriously disrupts your Plan of Action. This directly limits our ability to continue supporting your case.

Your file is now under management review, and I no longer have authority to make changes or delay further action. Without immediate resolution, your program is at serious risk.

Please confirm today if you are able to process a payment or provide an exact date when payment will be made. A delay at this point will result in the cancellation of your program, along with the permanent loss of legal protection and support.

Your urgent attention to this matter is critical.
